EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong band at 1005 cm⁻¹ characteristic of the benzene ring breathing mode in monosubstituted aromatics, plus aromatic C–H stretching near 3065 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and multiple ring C=C stretches at 1588–1630 cm⁻¹ typical of an aromatic ring. A weak band at 1681 cm⁻¹ is consistent with an aromatic aldehyde C=O stretch, and the broad 2929 cm⁻¹ band matches aliphatic C–H from a methyl substituent (present in candidate 3). Additional bands near 754 and 806 cm⁻¹ fit aromatic C–H out-of-plane bending. Candidate 3 (methylbenzaldehyde-type structure) uniquely matches the combined aromatic + aldehyde features among the candidates.
